# DeepSeek V4 Flash 部署与性能知识图谱

## 系统整体概览
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    HW["6× V100 32G GPU"]
    Model["DeepSeek V4 Flash (Q4)"]
    Software["DAACPP + LLaMA.cpp"]
    MOE["Mixture of Experts (MOE) 架构"]
    MemUsage["模型显存占用 150‑158 GB"]
    Throughput["单并发 25 tokens/s"]
    ThroughputMulti["3 并发 15 tokens/s"]
    Power["峰值 250 W，平均 40‑50 W"]
    Cost["整机成本约 3 万人民币"]
    UseCase["企业内部客服 / 知识库 / Agent"]
    Access["本地 IP + 端口，网页访问，无登录限制"]

    HW --> Model
    Model --> Software
    Software --> MOE
    MOE --> Power
    Model --> MemUsage
    Throughput --> UseCase
    ThroughputMulti --> UseCase
    Cost --> UseCase
    Access --> UseCase
```

## 并发性能与功耗关系
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Single["单并发"]
    Multi3["3 并发"]
    TokensSingle["25 tokens/s"]
    TokensMulti["15 tokens/s"]
    SpeedIncrease["单并发比多并发快约 60‑70%"]
    ConcurrentUsers["可服务 10‑30 人"]
    PowerAvg["平均功耗 40‑50 W"]
    PowerPeak["峰值功耗 250 W"]
    Scaling["并发数 ↑，功耗 ↑，速度 ↓（轻微）"]

    Single --> TokensSingle
    Multi3 --> TokensMulti
    TokensSingle --> SpeedIncrease
    TokensMulti --> SpeedIncrease
    SpeedIncrease --> ConcurrentUsers
    ConcurrentUsers --> PowerAvg
    PowerAvg --> PowerPeak
    Multi3 --> Scaling
    Single --> Scaling
```

## 部署工作流
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Download["下载 5 个 GUF 文件"]
    Setup["配置 LLaMA.cpp 参数（context、等）"]
    StartServer["启动本地服务器（IP+端口）"]
    WebUI["通过浏览器访问"]
    MultiPort["开启多端口并发"]
    Test["性能测试（单/多并发）"]
    Monitor["观察日志（token/s）"]
    Deploy["交付软硬件一体化方案"]

    Download --> Setup --> StartServer --> WebUI
    StartServer --> MultiPort --> Test --> Monitor --> Deploy
```

flowchart TD

    TotalCost["总拥有成本低"]

    PowerCost --> Benefit
    Performance --> Benefit
    UserCapacity --> Benefit

    Benefit --> Maintenance

    Benefit --> License
    Benefit --> TotalCost
